title: Palace on super typhoon Rosal: ‘Sana mahina lang, magandang pagkakataon para makapag-ipon ng tubig’
summary: Malacañang on Wednesday said that it hopes super typhoon Rosal’s impact would not be too severe so that it could be a good opportunity to ease the El Niño’s impact on the Philippines.
